name: song-upload-worker
description: Takes mp3 and image uploads with the upload key into R2 and serves them to anyone.

scripts.dev:test: node -e "require('fs').rmSync('.wrangler/test', { recursive: true, force: true })" && wrangler dev --persist-to .wrangler/test --port 8788 --var UPLOAD_KEY:test-upload-key-0123456789 --var CAP_BYTES:400000000
